title: MagMAX Plant DNA Isolation Kit Automation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the ThermoFischer MagMAX Plant DNA Isolation Kit on up to 96 samples. The entire workflow is broken into 2 different protocols. This is part 2, DNA purification. In this protocol, 25µL of magnetic beads plus 400µL of ethanol is added to 400µL of sample (from [part 1](https://develop.protocols.opentrons.com/protocol/49de51-pt1)). After off-deck mixing, the plate is returned to the OT-2 for supernatant removal. This process continues with wash buffer 1, wash buffer 2, and the elution buffer. However, the supernatant of the elution buffer is preserved in a 96-well PCR plate and can be used for further downstream application. **Update April 26, 2021**: The addition of magnetic beads has been made optional. **Update May 3, 2021**: A second wash step has been added and heights of aspiration adjusted. **Update June 8, 2021**: Added the ability to park tips. This will cut down on tip usage when using 48+ samples. steps.title: Gather required hardware
steps.instruction: Collect the following equipment: Opentrons OT‑2 robot, OT‑2 Run App version 3.21.0 or later, Magnetic Module GEN2, p300 multi‑channel pipette mounted on the right side, 200 µL filter tip rack, NEST 1‑well reservoir (195 mL), and any other labware required by the deck map.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and samples
steps.instruction: Ensure you have the ThermoFisher MagMAX Plant DNA Isolation Kit reagents for part 2 (DNA purification) and up to 96 samples that have been processed in part 1. Label a 96‑well plate for the DNA purification step.

steps.title: Add beads and ethanol
steps.instruction: To each well containing 400 µL of sample, add 25 µL magnetic beads and 400 µL ethanol. (Note: the addition of magnetic beads is optional as of the April 26 2021 update.)

steps.title: Mix off‑deck and remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the OT‑2, mix the contents off‑deck, then place the plate back on the OT‑2 for magnetic separation and supernatant removal.

substeps.instruction: Off‑deck: vortex or pipette‑mix the well to resuspend beads.
Return plate to OT‑2, engage magnetic module, and aspirate the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer 1
steps.instruction: Add Wash Buffer 1 to each well, allow beads to bind, engage the magnetic module, and remove the wash supernatant.

steps.title: Wash with Buffer 2
steps.instruction: Add Wash Buffer 2 to each well, repeat magnetic separation, and remove the wash supernatant. (A second wash step was added on May 3 2021; aspiration heights have been adjusted accordingly.)

steps.title: Elute DNA and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Add Elution Buffer to each well, incubate as recommended, engage the magnetic module, and transfer the eluate (supernatant) to a 96‑well PCR plate for downstream applications.

steps.title: Enable tip parking (optional)
steps.instruction: If processing 48 or more samples, activate tip‑parking in the protocol to reduce tip consumption (added June 8 2021).

steps.title: Upload custom labware definition
steps.instruction: If your labware is not already in the OT‑2 library, upload a custom labware definition file before running the protocol.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Import the protocol bundle into the OT‑2 Run App.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck layout exactly as shown in the provided deck map, placing tip racks, reservoir, magnetic module, and sample plate in their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the OT‑2 calibration routine for all labware, tip racks, and the p300 multi‑channel pipette using the calibration tips.

steps.title: Execute the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 Run App to start the automated DNA purification workflow.
